claims.archetype: Meander (invented, the brook spine): one continuous generative line swings across the full viewport width down the whole page; every section docks on the bank opposite the swing so both halves of every width are occupied; section labels ride the line as standing tags; media bands and the signature scene run edge to edge
claims.governing_idea: Every receipt you ever paid is one long tape, and Brainbrook keeps the whole tape crisp so the money printed on it can still come back.

signature_world.object: one continuous thermal receipt tape carrying the household's whole ledger, meandering like a brook across a pale celadon field, with HSA and FSA tags standing on its owed back lines
signature_world.camera_path: low rail ride along the winding tape from today's line back to the oldest receipt (Feb 11, 2023) while faded print resolves crisp beneath the camera, then a straight lift up the axis to a held birdseye where the tape reads as a brook and the tags light back toward today as $1,284.00 counts into view (Coming Back Into View), then a descent to the tape's end as it tears off into the phone's ledger

claims.archetype: Split-Screen Diptych (cast as the Two-Source Diptych)
claims.governing_idea: Turn it over: every record in a claim file has a front, what it asserts, and a reverse, what it actually carries, and Logifx lays the two sides beside each other so the conflict is something you see, not something you are told.

signature_world.object: a single photographic print from the claim file (Photo 07, a creased quarter panel in a body shop bay) hanging in a baize void, with its metadata etched on the reverse
signature_world.camera_path: frontal hold while the print turns 90 degrees to edge on, continue to 180 for the reverse side, then a straight fly through the conflict ring to the far side where the field inverts to ash and the other four exhibits stand already turned

palette.color_story: green baize and silver, an analogous green two field system with one carmine ring for the conflict

claims.body_font: Instrument Sans (words) with Martian Mono (citations and metadata)
claims.motif: the ring at the seam: a seam bisecting a ring, two ticks that stop short; fills to a disc when the sides agree, collapses to a grey square when a source is silent
claims.loader_transition: latent image loader: the wordmark and the claims investigation descriptor develop from a faint grey ghost to full silver in the right half of the diptych in step with real load, then the developed plate turns edge on and hands off into the hero print's first frame
claims.nav_style: spine header: transparent over the hero, gains a baize plate with a silver hairline and a 4px edge on scroll, wordmark plus claims investigation descriptor top left, horizontal two sided link plates that turn on their vertical axis on hover to show an italic serif reverse, active link held on its reverse, a seam tick at the exact centre, cart plate top right
claims.button_style: extruded silver plate: solid silver rectangle with radius 2 and a 4px ash edge, deep baize sans label, tilts up to 6 degrees toward the pointer and lifts as the edge grows on hover, flattens onto its edge on press, a 1px light travels the edge at idle, ring focus
claims.typographic_set_piece: The Turned Word: the H1 phrase 'disagrees with itself' turns word by word on its vertical axis to its italic reverse carrying the citation that proves it; the same turn is the Home text hover treatment

claims.archetype: Illustrated Scroll World, cast as Walking Home (the rendered lot at dusk fills the viewport edge to edge at every width; type docks in a calm reading measure with the world doing the visual work at both sides; the five windows double as always visible progress)
claims.governing_idea: Lights on: an estate plan is a house at dusk where every window comes on as a step is finished, and the plan is done when all five are lit and the property line closes around the lot in the colour of the last light, because a trust controls only what it owns.

signature_world.object: a household at dusk: a linen house on its lot with five lights (four windows and a porch light) that come on one by one as the five steps complete, and a property line that closes around the lot in the rose of the last light, all drawn by one raymarched program (The Dusk Lot)
signature_world.camera_path: eye height dolly along the front walk while the windows light one by one, then a pendulum arc up and over the roof to a held birdseye where the property line draws and closes, then a descent to the porch as the porch light comes on

palette.color_story: last light: dusk plum field, lamplit linen rooms and one rose

claims.archetype: Warp Columns (invented: five content columns edge to edge, one per money thread, every section a row across them, heading passes between rows)
claims.governing_idea: Five threads run through every working month (savings rates, cashback, coupons, the seasons, the paycheck), and each weekday morning SaveBrew weaves the day's pass and hands you the five knots worth pulling.

signature_world.object: The Loom: five taut warp threads (one per money thread) spanning the full width and receding from the weaver's seat, the day's weft passing and knotting once on each, the woven weeks behind
signature_world.camera_path: cross-section sweep then gravity flip: the reed sweeps toward the camera through the woven weeks revealing one day's row of knots per pass, today's knots pull tight on a held beat, then the camera pitches to top down and the cloth lays flat into the five-column board

palette.color_story: butter warp through a white weft, with indigo thread

claims.motif: The Knot: a vertical warp line crossed by a weft loop that passes over, under and pulls tight
claims.loader_transition: selvedge stitch: a dashed indigo running stitch draws down the left gutter in step with real load over the already painted page, ties off at ready, no count, no Flip, skip at the bottom centre
claims.nav_style: the heading band: opaque white weft band 84px that hides on scroll down and returns on scroll up, Big Shoulders wordmark with the knot mark top left, four destination links in Manrope with the active link at weight 800 and no marker glyph, About, Contact and Sign in at right, a spool cart glyph with stitched count and the compact stitched Bobbin
claims.button_style: the Bobbin: squat rectangle radius 4 with an inset dashed stitch border, indigo fill and butter label; stitches run on hover, fill deepens and stitch tightens on press, one stitch travels the border every eleven seconds at idle; price never inside
claims.typographic_set_piece: The Tightening: every glyph of the home H1 sits at wght 500 at first paint and pulls to wght 800 left to right at 18ms per glyph as the weft knots the five warps
